description: Directory of NCUA-insured credit unions. (Source: NCUA.) Dollar amounts are in thousands of US dollars ($000s): NCUA files the 5300 in whole dollars and this API divides by 1,000 so credit unions read like banks. Ratios are percentages.

q.description: Name or NCUA charter number, case-insensitive. Matches any part of the legal name; when that finds nothing, falls back to the site's name matcher, which forgives punctuation, spacing and common abbreviations.
